newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index inches higher.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index inches higher.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 1.49 points, or 2.21 percent higher at 68.81 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index gained 34.37 points to 3035.61.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 16.83 percent after 15.51 percent on Wednesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
